remarks: Highest & Best Monday @ 5pm (7/14)- Charming Cape Cod Home with Spacious Backyard and Prime Location. Nestled on a quiet street, this classic New England home beautifully captures the charm and character of Connecticut living. Featuring a large backyard and an expansive deck, it's the perfect setting for outdoor entertaining or peaceful relaxation. Inside, you'll find three bedrooms-two located on the upper level and a primary bedroom conveniently situated on the main floor, adjacent to a full bathroom. The kitchen, equipped with newer appliances including a refrigerator, oven, dishwasher, and microwave, flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. Direct access from the kitchen to the attached garage makes bringing in groceries a breeze. A delightful room faces the backyard and features large ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light-ideal for a home office, sunroom, or playroom. Major updates include a new asphalt shingle roof, a newer oil tank located in the basement (additional 870 SqFt Unfinished), and a newer hot water heater. Two zoned heating. Located just minutes from downtown and a short walk to Springdale Train Station which will take you to NYC directly or a quick connect at Stamford Train Station. 22 Brundage offers convenience, comfort, and a lovely street appeal, a wonderful opportunity for the next homeowner!
